integrity: The fourth cumulant is proved for all integer orders by a signed incidence-spectrum calculation. A standalone exact verifier tests finite cases; its checks are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only independent fair complete-graph orientations and is not a result for biased tournaments. Classical circular-triad moment methods predate this exact treatment, and historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A sharp fourth-cumulant transition for circular triads in uniform tournaments
